jobs.title: IT Project Sr Group Manager
jobs.description:
The IT Project Sr Group Manager manages multiple teams through other managers. In-depth understanding of how own sub-function contributes to achieving the objectives of the function. A good understanding of the industry, direct competitors' products and services, is also necessary in order to contribute to the commercial objectives of the business. Requires thorough understanding of strategic direction of the function within the relevant part of the business, combined with a solid conceptual/practical grounding in both the function and/or area of expertise and related subject areas. Excellent communication skills required in order to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Some external communication/negotiation may be necessary. Responsible for executing functional strategy in area managed. Determines approach to implementing functional strategy. Accountable for end results, budgeting, planning, policy formulation and contribution to future strategy of the area(s). Impact reflects size of team managed, strategic influence on the business and interaction with other functions or businesses. Full management responsibility for multiple teams, including management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary actions and terminations and budget approval. May be doing involved or responsible for diverse (cross-discipline) activities. Typically, a direct report to a C16 role and function as an intergral member of the functional leadership team within a country/site location, job family, or line of business.

Responsibilities:

Ensures IT projects are defined, tracked and communicated.
Partners with IT and business leadership and other key stakeholders to identify opportunities and to prioritize projects based on business needs.
Impacts the business by exercising control over sizeable resources / budget, policy formulation and planning and by significant contribution to the future strategy of IT project leadership.
Evaluates subordinates' performance and makes decisions on pay increases, hiring, terminations and other personnel actions.
Applies a broad and comprehensive understanding in multiple functional areas as well as underlying business principles.
Establishes strategic plans for function.
Understands how the IT project leadership function integrates within the overall organization to contribute to achieving business objectives; requires a good working knowledge of the industry.
Provides evaluative judgment based on analysis of factual information in complicated, unique and dynamic situations; draws on diverse range of internal and external sources.
Influences and negotiates with senior leaders (across functions); may communicate with external parties.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Qualifications:

15+ years experience in a related technology role with commensurate people management experience

Education:

Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience, potentially Masters degree and managerial experience

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations (Remote)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Harte Hanks, we’re building a modern behavioral marketing company, marrying our data-driven understanding of human behavior with a seamless connection to the consumer. Through digital, direct, sampling, fulfillment, and customer care, we manage a full consumer experience that shortens the distance between behavior and action.

The Ask

The Senior Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations is responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost-effective operation of corporate technology services while leading the modernization and simplification of Harte Hanks’ infrastructure environment. This role oversees infrastructure and cloud operations, networking, systems engineering, workplace technology, service delivery, and key service providers. The Senior Manager translates the enterprise technology roadmap into measurable execution, with particular emphasis on data center exit, cloud and SaaS adoption, infrastructure consolidation, operational resilience, automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

You are a practical, hands-on technology leader who can operate today’s hybrid environment while deliberately reducing legacy complexity. You combine strong operational discipline with sound technical judgment, financial accountability, vendor management, and the ability to lead distributed teams through change. You know when to standardize, automate, outsource, consolidate, or retire technology, and you can balance modernization objectives with service continuity, security, compliance, and business needs. You communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and senior leaders, and you build a culture of ownership, transparency, customer service, and continuous learning.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and develop a distributed team responsible for infrastructure, cloud, systems, networking, workplace technology, service delivery, and operational support.
Maintain stable, secure, and resilient IT operations while driving a structured program to reduce legacy infrastructure and operational complexity.
Manage execution of the data center exit and infrastructure consolidation roadmap, including workload assessment, migration, decommissioning, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
Advance cloud-first and SaaS-first operating models where they provide measurable improvements in cost, scalability, resilience, security, and supportability.
Oversee corporate network services and connectivity, including deeper adoption and optimization of our Cato networking, while rationalizing site-based firewalls, switching, and other physical infrastructure where practical.
Own operational governance and cost management across Azure, AWS, SaaS platforms, network services, and infrastructure vendors, including budgeting, forecasting, utilization optimization, contract performance, and identification of savings opportunities.
Manage third-party vendors and support providers, ensuring responsibilities, service levels, deliverables, costs, risks, and performance expectations are clearly defined and met.
Establish effective monitoring, observability, alerting, incident response, problem management, change control, and service continuity practices across cloud and remaining on-premises environments.
Partner with information security to ensure infrastructure, identity, endpoint, network, and cloud services comply with company policies, control requirements, and recognized security practices.
Develop and maintain disaster recovery, resiliency, and business continuity capabilities appropriate to the company’s technology risk profile.
Work with senior IT leadership to convert enterprise technology strategy into prioritized, achievable initiatives with clear outcomes, owners, milestones, costs, dependencies, and risks.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to distinguish technical support needs from training, adoption, or process support and improve routing, ownership, and the overall employee support experience.
Ensure services, projects, and modernization initiatives are delivered within agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk parameters.
Define and document standards, operational procedures, reference patterns, support models, inventories, and service ownership across the technology environment.
Establish and report meaningful SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, operational risks, and modernization progress measures.
Use Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and related Atlassian capabilities to manage operational work, projects, documentation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
Promote practical use of automation, infrastructure as code, artificial intelligence, and modern operations practices to reduce manual work and improve service quality.
Support audits and compliance activities, including SOX, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, and client control requests, as applicable.
Occasionally interact with Harte Hanks clients regarding technology operations, controls, or modernization initiatives.

Requirements

Demonstrated success leading infrastructure, cloud, IT operations, or service delivery teams through modernization and organizational change.
Bachelor’s degree in a technology-related discipline or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, systems, or technology operations.
3+ years managing technology professionals, preferably across distributed or globally remote teams supporting business-critical services.
Experience planning and executing data center exits, cloud migrations, infrastructure consolidation, platform modernization, or large-scale technology rationalization.
Strong working knowledge of Azure and/or AWS, enterprise networking, identity, endpoint management, compute, storage, resiliency, disaster recovery, and hybrid environments.
Experience operating and optimizing modern network and security platforms; experience with Cato or comparable SASE/SD-WAN services is strongly preferred.
Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, incident, problem, change, request, asset, and service-level management practices; ITIL experience is preferred.
Demonstrated experience with Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and related Atlassian capabilities.
Experience managing technology budgets, cloud and SaaS consumption, vendors, managed services, contracts, renewals, and cost optimization.
Understanding of cybersecurity practices for endpoint security, identity and access management, network security, vulnerability management, logging, monitoring, and incident response.
Experience supporting regulated or audited environments and responding to internal, external, or client audit requests.
Working knowledge of infrastructure as code, automation, and scripting using tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, Ansible, or comparable technologies.
Ability to develop roadmaps, business cases, standards, procedures, operating models, and meaningful operational reporting.
Strong leadership, coaching, delegation, prioritization, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical, operational, financial, and risk considerations to senior leaders and business stakeholders.
Calm, credible, and decisive during incidents, competing priorities, and periods of organizational change.
Up to 10% travel may be required based on project and site needs.
Azure, AWS, ITIL, security, networking, or project management certifications are a plus.

What We Offer

Health Savings Account (HSA)
Educational Assistance
Voluntary plans, including critical illness, accident, and hospitalization
401(k) plan with Company Match and Roth contributions | Immediate vesting

jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization operates in the federal IT and digital transformation sector, focusing on enterprise modernization and systems integration programs for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). It addresses challenges related to large-scale IT modernization within government agencies, managing complex, multi-year initiatives with significant technical and organizational dependencies.

About the Opportunity:

The SENIOR IT PROGRAM MANAGER will lead a complex, multi-year enterprise modernization and systems integration program for the VA. This role is accountable for the overall program execution, including planning, implementation, and operational stabilization. The manager ensures coordinated delivery across multiple technical and functional workstreams and acts as the primary delivery executive interfacing with senior stakeholders. This position plays a critical role in translating mission objectives into actionable plans and governance frameworks to achieve successful program outcomes.

Responsibilities:

Lead end-to-end program execution from mobilization through operational stabilization and continuous improvement.
Establish and lead an integrated PMO covering program controls, scheduling, financial/resource management, risk management, quality management, and reporting.
Direct multiple concurrent technical and functional workstreams with focus on dependencies, risks, and timely delivery.
Collaborate with deputy leadership to advance readiness and milestone achievement.
Serve as the principal executive liaison with VA executives, program leadership, technical and business stakeholders.
Develop executable roadmaps, governance cadence, integrated delivery plans, staffing models, and performance measures.
Oversee program-level planning and control for ITSM/ESM, asset management, service catalogs, workflow automation, integrations, data management, testing, training, and organizational change.
Manage staffing, personnel readiness, surge planning, subcontractor coordination, and workforce retention.
Maintain disciplined execution of schedules, risk and issue logs, dashboards, status reports, quality plans, and deliverables.
Manage financial performance and labor forecasting in partnership with contracts and finance teams.
Lead executive steering committees, program and risk reviews, and workstream meetings.
Identify and mitigate risks related to readiness, data, integrations, staffing, stakeholder alignment, and scheduling.
Support proposal, presentations, customer engagement, and transition activities as a key personnel.

Requirements:

15+ years of experience delivering large, complex federal IT, digital transformation, enterprise platform, ERP, or systems integration programs.
10+ years in senior program or portfolio management roles with accountability for delivery, customer engagement, staffing, scheduling, financial performance, risk, and subcontractor leadership.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise programs with multiple concurrent workstreams and significant technical interdependencies.
Experience managing programs of significant scale, preferably $100M+ budgets and 75+ full-time employees.
Proven ability to establish and operate PMOs with integrated master schedules, program controls, risk and financial management, change control, reporting, and deliverable governance.
Experienced in leading accelerated implementation, transition, modernization, or operational readiness efforts with fixed milestones and high executive visibility.
Skilled in managing complex stakeholder groups across business, IT, security, architecture, operations, procurement, and executive leadership.
Experience managing prime and subcontractor teams, staffing pipelines, surge requirements, and cross-company delivery governance.
Familiarity with Agile, hybrid Agile, or iterative delivery methods within formal federal program management controls.
Strong executive communication skills with ability to lead senior meetings, brief executives, and resolve escalated issues.
PMP certification required.
Training or demonstrated experience in Agile delivery, Scrum, SAFe, or a comparable scaled Agile approach.
Working knowledge of federal program management disciplines including performance management, integrated scheduling, risk management, and governance.

Clearance Requirement:
Ability to obtain and maintain VA suitability, access, and system credentials.
U.S. citizenship or eligibility to obtain required VA credentials.

jobs.description:
Director of Information Technology

Waylin Partners, a leading provider of FP&A, data, and accounting consulting services, is seeking a Director of Information Technology to lead and manage the firm’s internal technology infrastructure, security, and IT operations.
In this role, you will own Waylin’s day-to-day technology environment while helping build the systems, processes, and security framework needed to support a growing, fully remote organization. You will partner closely with firm leadership, Operations, and Talent while managing external technology vendors and serving as the primary internal point of contact for IT.
This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable setting technology strategy and rolling up their sleeves to solve day-to-day technical challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Own the firm’s internal IT environment, including hardware, software, identity and access management, endpoint management, networking, and cloud-based systems
Manage the full technology lifecycle for employees, including laptop procurement, configuration, deployment, onboarding, support, replacement, and offboarding
Oversee Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, SharePoint, Teams, and other core business applications
Manage device enrollment, configuration, patching, compliance, and endpoint security across a fully remote workforce
Develop and maintain standardized IT onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure timely provisioning and removal of system access
Own cybersecurity strategy and controls, including endpoint protection, MFA, access policies, vulnerability management, incident response, and employee security awareness
Manage relationships with third-party IT providers, software vendors, and security partners, including monitoring service levels and holding vendors accountable for performance
Establish and maintain IT policies, documentation, asset inventories, access controls, and technology standards
Partner with leadership to evaluate and implement new technology, automation, AI, and productivity tools
Support technology requirements related to client security reviews, compliance initiatives, cyber insurance, and other information security requests
Develop a scalable technology roadmap that supports the firm’s continued growth

Examples of Workstreams

Managing laptop deployment and technology onboarding for new hires across a fully remote workforce
Building a standardized device lifecycle program for procurement, deployment, inventory management, replacement, and secure decommissioning
Managing Microsoft Intune and Entra ID policies for device management, authentication, and access
Monitoring endpoint compliance, security updates, patching, and vulnerability remediation
Evaluating the firm’s cybersecurity posture and implementing improvements to reduce risk
Managing and evaluating the performance of the firm’s managed service provider and other technology vendors
Improving onboarding and offboarding automation across Microsoft 365 and other business systems
Evaluating new software and AI tools for security, functionality, integration, and business value
Developing disaster recovery, business continuity, and incident response procedures
Leading technology projects such as system migrations, software implementations, security enhancements, and vendor transitions

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field
6+ years of experience in information technology, IT operations, infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity, or related roles
Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Azure AD, Intune, Teams, and Windows environments
Experience with endpoint management, device deployment, identity and access management, patch management, and cybersecurity tools
Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including MFA, conditional access, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, phishing prevention, and incident response
Experience managing MSPs and other third-party technology vendors
Experience supporting a remote or geographically distributed workforce strongly preferred
Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues while also developing scalable processes and long-term technology strategy
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and risks to non-technical stakeholders
High degree of ownership, judgment, and discretion when working with confidential company and employee information

jobs.title: Director, Technical Support - Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Whether you’re an experienced professional or just getting started, your contributions matter at Fortra. If you’re passionate about tackling meaningful challenges alongside talented team members committed to helping each other succeed, all while having lots of fun, we want to hear from you. We offer competitive benefits and salaries, personal and professional development opportunities, flexibility, and much more!

In this role, you will lead the global Cybersecurity Technical Support organization, accountable for delivering responsive, scalable, and high-quality support across on-prem, hybrid, SaaS, and managed services environments. You will set the strategy, operating model, and performance standards needed to improve customer experience, accelerate issue resolution, reduce backlog aging, and prevent recurring issues.

You will lead and develop a high-performing global team while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Managed Services to resolve complex customer issues and turn customer feedback into measurable improvements. You will also drive the responsible adoption of AI, automation, analytics, and self-service capabilities to improve responsiveness, strengthen proactive support, and enable support teams and customers to resolve issues more effectively.

What You'll Do

Leadership & Strategy

Develop and implement the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Cybersecurity Technical Support organization in alignment with company goals.
Lead, mentor, and manage a global team of technical support engineers, managers, and specialists.
Drive operational excellence through the adoption of best practices, metrics, and continuous improvement processes.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to ensure customer feedback informs product development and enhancements.

Operations Management

Own the performance and health of the Technical Support organization, including SLA attainment, first-response time, time to resolution, backlog volume and aging, customer satisfaction, support cost efficiency, and reduction of recurring customer issues. Establish clear performance targets, review trends regularly, and lead corrective actions when results are below expectations.
Establish an effective follow-the-sun support model that provides clear ownership, consistent customer experience, and seamless handoffs across teams, regions, and support tiers. Ensure the organization has the skills, coverage, tools, and operating discipline needed to meet customer commitments and support business growth.
Own and manage escalation processes to handle high-priority or complex incidents in a timely and effective manner.
Design and manage a follow the sun, 24x7 support model, ensuring around the clock availability with seamless ticket handoff.
Implement and maintain a knowledge base to empower both customers and support staff with self-service options.

Customer Advocacy

Act as a voice of the customer, championing their needs within the organization.
Partner with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues, prioritize defect resolution, and address underlying causes that create avoidable customer effort, repeat cases, or prolonged resolution times. Track improvement actions through implementation and validate their impact on customer experience and support performance.
Build strong relationships with key customers, understanding their unique requirements and ensuring their success with our solutions.
Use the voice of the customer to identify and implement process improvements to enhance the customer experience.
Lead the post-mortem analysis for critical incidents, driving root cause analysis and recommending preventative measures.

Technology & Transformation

Evaluate and deploy tools, platforms, and technologies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the Technical Support team.
Leverage analytics and data-driven insights to make informed decisions and optimize support operations.
Define and execute an AI-enabled support strategy that improves customer responsiveness, accelerates issue resolution, reduces backlog aging, and increases the effectiveness of support engineers.
Establish an operating model for AI-assisted case management that uses customer tier, case severity, product, entitlement, SLA risk, and case history to identify and prioritize work requiring immediate attention.
Use predictive analytics to identify emerging support trends, recurring defects, backlog risk, and customers at risk of delayed resolution; mobilize the appropriate teams before service levels or customer experience are adversely affected.
Improve knowledge quality and self-service effectiveness through technology assisted knowledge creation, content recommendations, and identification of knowledge gaps based on customer demand and case patterns.
Ensure AI solutions are implemented with appropriate human oversight, data privacy, security controls, quality assurance, and measurable business outcomes.
Measure the impact of technology and AI-enabled support capabilities through improvements in response time, resolution time, SLA attainment, backlog aging, case deflection, engineer productivity, and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience leading technical support teams in a Managed Services and SaaS environment.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threats, tools, and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including firewalls, endpoint protection, intrusion detection systems, and SIEM tools.
Familiarity with delivery models, service-level agreements (SLAs), and multi-tenant SaaS environments.
Proficiency with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Understanding of ITIL frameworks and ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
Excellent leadership, coaching, and people's management skills.
Exceptional problem-solving abilities and decision-making under pressure.
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with IT service management (ITSM) frameworks, such as ITIL, is a plus.

new_jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
new_jobs.description:
Director of Information Technology

Waylin Partners, a leading provider of FP&A, data, and accounting consulting services, is seeking a Director of Information Technology to lead and manage the firm’s internal technology infrastructure, security, and IT operations.
In this role, you will own Waylin’s day-to-day technology environment while helping build the systems, processes, and security framework needed to support a growing, fully remote organization. You will partner closely with firm leadership, Operations, and Talent while managing external technology vendors and serving as the primary internal point of contact for IT.
This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable setting technology strategy and rolling up their sleeves to solve day-to-day technical challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Own the firm’s internal IT environment, including hardware, software, identity and access management, endpoint management, networking, and cloud-based systems
Manage the full technology lifecycle for employees, including laptop procurement, configuration, deployment, onboarding, support, replacement, and offboarding
Oversee Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, SharePoint, Teams, and other core business applications
Manage device enrollment, configuration, patching, compliance, and endpoint security across a fully remote workforce
Develop and maintain standardized IT onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure timely provisioning and removal of system access
Own cybersecurity strategy and controls, including endpoint protection, MFA, access policies, vulnerability management, incident response, and employee security awareness
Manage relationships with third-party IT providers, software vendors, and security partners, including monitoring service levels and holding vendors accountable for performance
Establish and maintain IT policies, documentation, asset inventories, access controls, and technology standards
Partner with leadership to evaluate and implement new technology, automation, AI, and productivity tools
Support technology requirements related to client security reviews, compliance initiatives, cyber insurance, and other information security requests
Develop a scalable technology roadmap that supports the firm’s continued growth

Examples of Workstreams

Managing laptop deployment and technology onboarding for new hires across a fully remote workforce
Building a standardized device lifecycle program for procurement, deployment, inventory management, replacement, and secure decommissioning
Managing Microsoft Intune and Entra ID policies for device management, authentication, and access
Monitoring endpoint compliance, security updates, patching, and vulnerability remediation
Evaluating the firm’s cybersecurity posture and implementing improvements to reduce risk
Managing and evaluating the performance of the firm’s managed service provider and other technology vendors
Improving onboarding and offboarding automation across Microsoft 365 and other business systems
Evaluating new software and AI tools for security, functionality, integration, and business value
Developing disaster recovery, business continuity, and incident response procedures
Leading technology projects such as system migrations, software implementations, security enhancements, and vendor transitions

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field
6+ years of experience in information technology, IT operations, infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity, or related roles
Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Azure AD, Intune, Teams, and Windows environments
Experience with endpoint management, device deployment, identity and access management, patch management, and cybersecurity tools
Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including MFA, conditional access, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, phishing prevention, and incident response
Experience managing MSPs and other third-party technology vendors
Experience supporting a remote or geographically distributed workforce strongly preferred
Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues while also developing scalable processes and long-term technology strategy
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and risks to non-technical stakeholders
High degree of ownership, judgment, and discretion when working with confidential company and employee information
